title: Past Tense
description: Learn to talk about things that happened before.
competenceGoals: use simple verb forms in English

content.content:
## Past Tense - What Happened Before

The past tense tells us about things that already happened - yesterday, last week, or a long time ago.

content.title: Past Tense - Regular Verbs
content.content:
For most verbs, we add **-ed** to make the past tense:

- play → play**ed** (I played yesterday)
- walk → walk**ed** (She walked to school)
- watch → watch**ed** (We watched a movie)
- like → lik**ed** (He liked the food)

**Note:** If the verb ends in -e, just add -d:
- like → liked
- dance → danced

content.title: Irregular Verbs
content.content:
Some common verbs don't follow the -ed rule. You need to learn them!

**Common irregular verbs:**
| Now | Past |
|-----|------|
| go | went |
| see | saw |
| eat | ate |
| have | had |
| do | did |
| make | made |
| come | came |
| say | said |
| take | took |
| get | got |

content.title: Example: Past Tense Sentences
content.problem:
Change these sentences to past tense:
1. "I play with my friends."
2. "She goes to the store."
content.solution:
1. "I **played** with my friends." (play + ed)
2. "She **went** to the store." (go → went, irregular)

content.title: Time Words for Past
content.content:
These words often go with past tense:
- yesterday
- last week/month/year
- two days ago
- this morning
- when I was little

**Example:** "Yesterday, I **went** to the park."

exercise.task: Write the past tense of these verbs:
hints: Some are regular (+ed), some are irregular

exercise.task:
Fill in the correct past tense verb:
"Yesterday, I (go) _____ to school. I (see) _____ my friend. We (play) _____ together."
exercise.solution: Yesterday, I went to school. I saw my friend. We played together.
hints: go and see are irregular, play is regular

exercise.task: Write three sentences about what you did last weekend. Use past tense.
exercise.solution: Example: "Last weekend, I visited my grandma. I ate cake. I played games with my cousin."

content.content:
## Oppsummering

I dette kapittelet har du lært:

- **Past tense**: We use it for things that already happened: yesterday, last week.
- **The -ed rule**: For most verbs we add -ed: play -> played, walk -> walked.
- **Irregular verbs**: Some verbs are special and must be learned: go -> went, eat -> ate.

### Hugs!
- Most verbs: add -ed for the past.
- Watch out for irregular verbs like go -> went!

exercise.task: What is the past tense of 'walk'?
What is the past tense of 'go'?
Which word often goes with the past tense?
Write the past tense of these verbs: watch, see, like.
exercise.solution: watch -> watched, see -> saw, like -> liked. 'See' is irregular (saw); the others add -ed (-d after -e).
